hash_verification: All REVIEW-INPUTS.json listed file sizes and SHA256 matched at review time; check_fusion_source.py reruns the narrow independent source-row audit.
direct_source_check: Independently parsed the original Racanelli2020 XML tables: T1 case IDs 7,12; T2 IDs55-65,100; 14 author-labelled EMC records in total. This verifies the recovered record set but does not prove 14 independent donors or complete public RNA coverage.
prior_art_and_measurement_challenge: Brenca2019 already reports the two TAF15 acceptors in human tumors and an engineered colony assay. Seven EWSR1 plus five TAF15 tumor rows and five matched frozen conditions are retained, but there is no inspected donor-by-isoform abundance table; matched conditions cannot be added as donors.
Filion2009's native NR4A3 delta-C observation is Western/protein evidence, not a quantitative endogenous RNA-isoform ratio. The lower fusion band has a source-stated degradation alternative.

Racanelli2020 is a selected diagnostic-panel validation series with one TAF15 record. A FISH-positive/fusion-not-detected record is assay-limited and cannot establish a missing transcript or new biology.
The 2013 custom-array source reports its one EMC fusion boundary itself and supplies no recurrent partner comparison.
omission_and_gap_challenge: The packet explicitly retains Brenca raw alias/frozen crosswalk, Racanelli processed fusion calls/raw metadata, broader tissue RNA and cohort overlap as pending rather than negative. These are unresolved if a claim later advances. The narrow review did not independently search every possible RNA repository and does not certify complete public evidence coverage.
validity: A scoped source/value stop is justified; no new numerical EMC transcript comparison was actually performed. No biological absence or partner-effect conclusion is justified.
scientific_value: Known acceptor presence and native delta-C cannot be repackaged as a new EMC discovery. With only one TAF15 record in the new panel source and no direct processed donor-by-isoform matrix, a new useful recurrent contrast is not presently demonstrated.
decision: Agree with SHELVE of this standalone candidate. Reopen only for an authenticated junction-resolved all-condition donor map and a consequential hypothesis beyond the original observations, with capture/coverage controls and independent novelty challenge.
scope: Independent challenge of the R7 source gate and eligibility, not a complete raw RNA reanalysis or manuscript approval.
